name: docs add / edit: entry and feature commands
description: Commands to create and change docs without hand-editing YAML: docs add <feature>[/<entry>] (new feature, or new entry with --kind, --summary, --body, --path/--anchor/--keyword hints), docs edit <feature>[/<entry>] (change summary, body, kind, when hints, feature status), docs rm <feature>[/<entry>]. Validates kinds against config.yaml and entry ids; anchors created from path:line via the anchor model; stamps created/updated through the #25 rules. Same conventions as issues: --json, exit codes, --root, interactive prompts when input is missing, non-interactive mode, git add/mv, lock.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
